reviewScope: G1.1-B founder-loop.sh harness — RE-review of sprint-9 FIND-901..903 fixes

evidence.description: FIND-901 CLOSED. FOUNDER_LEDGER is now TEST-gated: `if [ "${FOUNDER_TEST:-}" = "1" ] && [ -n "${FOUNDER_LEDGER:-}" ]; then LEDGER="$FOUNDER_LEDGER"; else LEDGER="$DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl"; fi`. In prod (FOUNDER_TEST unset) the goal-check reads the env-INDEPENDENT $DIR/state/earn-ledger.jsonl — identical to record-earn.mjs:24 prod path. No env var can repoint it at an attacker file.

DIR is env-independent in prod: FOUNDER_DIR is gated behind FOUNDER_TEST=1; prod falls to the literal /Users/operator/.anicca-founder, mirroring record-earn.mjs:20. Enumerated all env reads (FOUNDER_TEST gate-only, FOUNDER_DIR gated, FOUNDER_LEDGER gated; HOME not read by harness) — NONE can move the ledger/STATE/founder-dir path in prod.

FIND-902 part(1) CLOSED. Static gate added: comments stripped via sed 's|#.*||' then `grep FOUNDER_LEDGER | grep -v FOUNDER_TEST` must be empty — asserts every FOUNDER_LEDGER read is FOUNDER_TEST-gated. A re-introduced ungated seam fails the suite.

FIND-903 corrupt-ledger behavioral case is REAL and exercises the prod-relative path: writes not-json to $T/state/earn-ledger.jsonl (NOT FOUNDER_LEDGER), asserts rc!=0 AND 'LEDGER UNREADABLE' in STATE — not a silent realised_earn=0.

Fail-safe case 4: corrupt cursor → recorder dies → asserts STATE still written + rc!=0 surfaced + NOT last_record_rc:0. A behavioral FOUNDER_TEST-unset prod-leak test is structurally impossible (prod DIR is intentionally non-relocatable without FOUNDER_TEST); the static gate is the correct fence.

FIND-903 CLOSED. jq error → `|| LEDGER_OK=0` surfaces UNREADABLE. Numeric guard `grep -qE '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'` correctly rejects '1.2.3' (two dots), 'abc', empty, and negatives. STATUS=EARNING (line 34) requires BOTH LEDGER_OK=1 AND $TOTAL>0, so no corrupt/non-numeric ledger can read as EARNING. `[ "$RC" = "0" ] && RC=1` (line 33) surfaces rc on unreadable ledger even if recorder succeeded.

awk "BEGIN{exit !($TOTAL>0)}" is injection-safe: TOTAL has passed the strict digits/one-dot regex before interpolation — no operators/semicolons possible. TOTAL is bounded by what record-earn legitimately summed from verified external on-chain inflows (INV-7); not attacker-influenced in prod.

PREV_EARN (anchored ^realised_earn_usdc: — does NOT match prev_realised_earn_usdc:, tail -1 dedups) feeds ONLY the informational prev_realised_earn_usdc field; it does NOT feed TOTAL/STATUS/RC. realised_earn_usdc=$TOTAL is summed fresh from the ledger every wake. STATE.md self-poisoning cannot inflate earnings or flip STATUS.

The remaining FIND-903 path-resolution duplication (harness re-derives LEDGER rather than asking record-earn) produces IDENTICAL prod results today (both = /Users/operator/.anicca-founder/state/earn-ledger.jsonl) and is fenced by the static seam-gate test (test-founder-loop.sh:22-23). Intentional mirroring is documented at lines 10/13-14. No current divergence surface; not dimension-failing.
STATE write is atomic and race-safe: tmp uses $$ (per-process unique) + mv (atomic rename) → STATE.md is never half-written; concurrent cadence fires cannot corrupt STATE.

INV-H2: the only ledger-mutating call is `node $RECORD ... </dev/null`; the harness never redirects to $LEDGER (verified: redirections are wake.log line 24 and STATE.md.tmp line 48 only). INV-H4: </dev/null + no `read`/prompt anywhere.

INV-H6 fail-safe: set -uo pipefail WITHOUT -e — a nonzero recorder RC does not abort; RC captured (line 24), STATE always written (line 48), rc surfaced via exit (line 52) AFTER durable write. record-earn cannot write a fake row (its own gates).

Prod env-independence holds across the whole chain: harness never sets/exports FOUNDER_TEST, so record-earn.mjs:14 TEST seams (FOUNDER_LOGS_JSON/CURSOR/BLOCK_NOW/BASE_RPC_URL/LEDGER) stay inert in prod.
